title: A simple root in a local ring is unique in its residue class (Stacks 06RR)
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a local ring, $f\in R[T]$ with derivative $f'$, and $a,b\in R$ with $f(a)=f(b)=0$, $a-b\in\mathfrak m$ and $f'(a)\notin\mathfrak m$. Then $a=b$.
